### Now Available: Unlock Faster, Granular Test Analysis With AI-Powered Insights Tools in Sauce API & MCP

Root-cause analysis and test failures are now available wherever your team already works, eliminating context switching and improving developer productivity. Sauce AI for Insights now works through MCP and a REST API, so a failed build can arrive with its explanation attached and your team spends less time digging through results.

**Key Capabilities**

- **Track Failure Trends:** Identify high-frequency test and platform failures across specific timeframes.

- **Detect Flaky Tests:** Highlight test instability early to maintain confidence in your test suite.

- **Query Sauce AI Directly:** Ask plain-language questions to receive immediate analysis, including root-cause breakdowns for failed tests.

- **Integrate Anywhere:** Access identical AI analysis via a REST endpoint to connect with CI pipelines, custom dashboards, and internal portals.

- **Monitor Build & Test Status:** Review passed, failed, and errored tests instantly without needing to open Insights.

- **Extract Usage Analytics:** Evaluate concurrency and test volume across teams and throughout your organization.


**Value & Impact**

- **Streamlined Workflows:** Gain root-cause insights and status updates directly into existing engineering environments, eliminating disruptive context switching.

- **Embedded Intelligence:** Automated AI diagnostics that plug into your build process regardless of where you work.

- **Cost-Efficient Out-of-the-Box Tools:** Provides built-in recommendations, answers, and test analyses, reducing overall token expenditure on customer-managed LLMs.


**Why this matters**

- Root cause analysis and status reporting are the top two things customers already ask Sauce AI for. Now they get those answers wherever they work best, reducing costly context switching.

- Teams can build AI analysis into their own workflows. A failed build can come with an explanation attached.

- Sauce AI for Insights offers direct answers, recommendations, test result analysis and test failure analysis out of the box = **reduced token spend on customer LLM.**


**Before you Start**

- _Read-only._ Both surfaces read your test data. They never write, edit, or delete.

- Responses include data freshness, so you know how current the results are.

- Access to Sauce AI for Insights API is enabled through Sauce AI for Insights. Ask your account manager for access.


**Technical Docs:**

- [Sauce AI Insights MCP Server](https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/sauce-mcp-tools/)

- [Sauce AI Insights API](https://docs.saucelabs.com/dev/api/insights/)
